lighthouse.interpretation: Observed (trace) LCP now equals FCP on every measured page (service 3387ms -> 1703ms observed): the hero text no longer waits for JS. Simulated mobile LCP is still 3.6-4.2s, i.e. NOT under the 2.5s target: Lantern attributes it to 3 render-blocking CSS chunks (~170-630ms each) and JS/hydration; single-run numbers vary +-5 perf points, so TBT/perf deltas on individual pages are within noise except home TBT (1230 -> 750ms, static HeroBackdrop on touch). gotchas: next/script afterInteractive inside a client component: SSR HTML only carries <link rel=preload> for the gtag src; the <script> tags (incl. inline id=ga4-init) are injected after hydration, so grep the hydrated DOM (headless Edge --dump-dom with --virtual-time-budget on a page without long intervals; the home page never settles under virtual time because of its intervals).
PowerShell: don't pipe the crawler into Select-Object -First N (it kills the process and reports exit -1); redirect to $null and read the report instead.
Lighthouse via npx needs CHROME_PATH pointing at msedge.exe on this machine; pass --no-enable-error-reporting to skip the interactive prompt.
